name: Google Sheets
category_description: App node - connects to an external service API
description: Use the Google Sheets node to automate work in Google Sheets, and integrate Google Sheets with other applications. n8n has built-in support for a wide range of Google Sheets features, including creating, updating, deleting, appending, removing and getting documents

options.name: Locale
options.description: Enter the locale of the spreadsheet. This affects formatting details such as functions, dates, and currency. Use one of the following formats:

options.name: Recalculation Interval
options.description: Enter the desired recalculation interval for the spreadsheet functions. This affects how often NOW, TODAY, RAND, and RANDBETWEEN are updated. Select On Change for recalculating whenever there is a change in the spreadsheet, Minute for recalculating every minute, or Hour for recalculating every hour.
